info.name: Virtual Office
info.summary: A small shared office for your Team or Talk conversation. See who's around and drop by before you start a call.
info.description:
Remote teams lose the small moments: seeing that someone is around, asking a quick question, having a coffee together. Virtual Office gives a Team, a group or a Talk conversation a small shared office in Nextcloud. See who is there, step in as a character and say hi before anyone has to start a call.
- **Knock first:** ask "got 2 minutes?"; they answer Now, In 10 minutes or Later - **Inside Talk:** open a conversation's office from any message menu, and join the call from there - **Talk to who's close:** turn on your mic and the people next to you hear you, louder the closer they stand - **Share the room:** make a coffee together, play music from your Files, keep a desk with a note for the day, or focus together for 25 or 50 minutes - **Across time zones:** see each person's local time and the hours you all share today - **Where you work:** offices show up on the Dashboard, in search, in the Smart Picker and on Team pages - **Your character:** a rabbit, cat, bear or bird in your color, in a large office or a small one for up to 12 people - **For everyone:** mouse, touch or keyboard, or the people and places list with a screen reader
**Privacy**
Opening an office never makes you visible: you choose Enter office. Only members of the Team, group or conversation can enter. Virtual Office keeps no history of visits or movement. Voice goes directly between browsers and is never recorded.
**Requirements**
Nextcloud 35, with no extra server. Talk adds conversation offices and calls (tested with Talk 25), and its STUN and TURN servers carry voice. Teams adds Team offices, Deck shows due cards on Team boards, and Client Push makes movement instant. Group offices work without other apps. Voice needs HTTPS.
See the office in motion at https://hweihwang.com/virtualoffice/
info.author: Hoang Pham
